scenePrompt: Create a wide 16:9 image of a young man in a mustard-yellow raincoat holding a small bouquet of sunflowers at a seaside bus stop at dawn. Show the bus stop, sea, and cloudy sky clearly. No typography.
stylePromptFromExecutedRead: Render the subject as a hand-painted watercolor illustration with contemporary Japanese animation-inspired drawing when people appear: simplified expressive faces and very fine pencil-like contours, never photorealistic skin. Layer transparent pigment over visible cold-press paper. Let pale powder-blue and warm beige washes bleed and pool softly in the background while retaining crisp, delicate detail at the focal face and hands.
